name: Ted's Hot Dogs (downtown Buffalo)
address: Chippewa St, ground floor of the Hampton Inn & Suites (between Delaware Ave and S Elmwood Ave)
closed_reason: Closed for good after a roughly 10-year run; a sign on the door said 'As of 10/24, this location is closed for good.' Other Ted's locations remain open.

name: Santora's Pizza Pub and Grill (Walden Galleria)
closed_reason: Owner Paul Santora chose not to renew the mall lease after five years; plans for a Clarence Center location also dropped. The Transit Road (Williamsville) pub stays open; the separate Santora's Pizzeria at 3440 Transit Rd, Depew, is unaffected.

name: Penora's Pizza
closed_reason: Closed after 48 years; the remaining owner retired and the property was put up for sale.

name: Michael's AJ Texas HOTS
closed_reason: Closed after more than 40 years; the building sold in October 2025. (AJ Texas Hots at 824 Foote Ave is a separate shop and is listed open.)

name: Nick Charlap's (West Seneca)
closed_reason: WKBW reported the West Seneca location is closing and the owners are looking for a new location (video headline only; details not read).

name: Bocce Club Pizza (Hertel Ave)
closed_reason: Closed when its licensing agreement expired; Bocce's Bailey Ave, Hopkins Rd, Goodrich Rd and Delaware Ave shops continued.
